intro.text: A mercenary whom Moash introduces to Kaladin.

items.text: Moash knew Rill from working caravans before joining the army, and Rill sought him out after Bridge Four was freed. Rill thought Elhokar an incompetent king who was ruining Alethkar, and believed Dalinar would make a better one. He was at the Ornery Chull when Moash tried to bring Kaladin into their cause.

appearance.text: He has dark, sunken eyes and short hair, wears heavy leathers and carries an axe. Kaladin pegs him as a mercenary at a glance.
